title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 243 (Consequence of termination or modification of agreements)

content.overview: Where an order under section 242 terminates or modifies an agreement with a manager or director, that person cannot, without the leave of the Tribunal, act as a manager or director of the company for five years.
content.glance: Where an order under section 242 terminates or modifies an agreement with a manager or director, that person cannot, without the leave of the Tribunal, act as a manager or director of the company for five years.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 243 (Consequence of termination or modification of agreements). Where an order under section 242 terminates or modifies an agreement with a manager or director, that person cannot, without the leave of the Tribunal, act as a manager or director of the company for five years. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The Central Government must be given notice of an application for leave. The section gives the removal teeth. It does not itself decide the oppression claim.
